anti_drift_rules: Incubate must not silently become Build Now without review.
Park must not accumulate execution tasks.
Archive must not be treated as current doctrine.

labels.label: build_now
labels.meaning: Ready to move toward execution planning or active work immediately after review.

labels.label: incubate
labels.meaning: Worth preserving and refining, but not yet ready for active execution.

labels.label: park
labels.meaning: Not active now; keep memory but do not spend execution energy on it.

labels.label: archive
labels.meaning: Historical memory kept for lineage or pattern extraction only.
